name: To Your Eternity
description: An immortal being takes on the form of a human boy, wandering the earth and experiencing the pains and joys of life throughout his story without end.

videos.title: Fushi's Journey
videos.overview: Recap of episodes 1 to 12 of season 1.

videos.title: The Last One
videos.overview: An orb is tossed upon the earth. It transforms to match its surrounding environment: first a rock, then moss, then a dying wolf. The wolf returns to its last remaining family, a boy living alone in a small home in the snow.

videos.title: A Rambunctious Girl
videos.overview: The orb, having morphed into a boy, finds its way to Ninanna, where he is attacked. He is discovered by a girl, March, who may not achieve her goal of becoming a grown-up.

videos.title: A Small Evolution
videos.overview: March is escorted to the altar to be sacrificed to Oniguma. Along the way, she tends to Fushi, who, despite having the body of a young man, doesn’t seem to have the mind of one.

videos.title: A Large Vessel
videos.overview: Hayase, interested in Fushi’s inability to die, brings him along with March, Parona and Pioran to the nation of Yanome. They are shown around town and treated well, but things are not as they seem.

videos.title: Those Who Follow
videos.overview: Fushi, March and Parona continue their escape from Yanome and back to Ninanna. Hayase chases after them, especially in order to capture Fushi.

videos.title: Our Goals
videos.overview: Having gained a semblance of humanity, Fushi sets off on his own. He encounters Pioran again, who teachers him words and writing, helping him live as a human being.

videos.title: The Boy Who Wants to Change
videos.overview: Fushi and Pioran arrive at Takunaha, where they meet Booze Man and a boy named Gugu. Gugu, who had been living with Booze Man for several months following an accident, warms up to Fushi.

videos.title: Monster Brothers
videos.overview: Fushi explains to Gugu how his form as the wolf, Joaan, and March, came to be. Gugu explains death to Fushi. Together, they come to understand the meaning of family.

videos.title: Deep Memories
videos.overview: Fushi tells Gugu about the wolf, Joaan, and the boy he took on the form of. Gugu explains death to Fushi, recalling his own past, working for a wealthy family with his brother.

videos.title: New Family
videos.overview: Fushi and Gugu fight against the Nokkers that they encountered in the forest. Though the situation is grim, Gugu has a trick up his sleeve.

videos.title: Gift From the Past
videos.overview: Four years after their encounter with the Nokkers, Fushi and Gugu have grown into fine young men. They’re invited to Rean’s birthday party after a brief reunion with Gugu’s brother.

videos.title: Awakening
videos.overview: Just as Gugu and Rean come to understand each other, the Nokkers emerge, causing panic in the party hall. Fushi and Gugu are forced to fight.

videos.title: Aspiring to Go Higher
videos.overview: Fushi leaves Booze Man’s home and sets out to wander aimlessly around Takunaha. He has many questions for the Observer, but can’t seem to get any straight answers.

videos.title: Jananda, Island of Freedom
videos.overview: Fushi and Pioran are separated on the prison island of Jananda. He enters a tournament where, if he survives until the end, he will be granted the right to do anything he wants – including leaving the island with Pioran.

videos.title: A Girl Named Tonari
videos.overview: Fushi transforms into Parona of Ninannah in the middle of the tournament. He is shocked when he realizes what this implies. Meanwhile, Tonari, desperate to have Fushi join her and her friends, offers to help rescue Pioran.

videos.title: The Children's Dreams
videos.overview: Fushi just barely manages to take down the Nokkers. He opens up to the others, and they discuss their dreams and pasts.

videos.title: The Defeated
videos.overview: Having defeated Fushi, Hayase makes a surprising proposal to the people of the island of Jananda.

videos.title: To Continue On
videos.overview: Tonari returns to Jananda to rescue Fushi. Before setting out again, they stay the night in a cave, and Tonari shares her past.

videos.title: Wandering Rage
videos.overview: Fushi, Tonari and their friends fight the Nokkers, who have taken over corpses.

videos.title: Echoes
videos.overview: Fushi parts ways with Tonari and heads to the port where Pioran is waiting for him. He worries that he may attract the Nokkers again and endanger her.

videos.title: Infatuation Reborn
videos.overview: Fushi, having spent several decades alone on an island, learns that a village was attacked by the Nokkers.

videos.title: Beating Will
videos.overview: Things do not go well when Tonari tries to remove the Nokker from Hisame's arm.

videos.title: The Awaited
videos.overview: Kahaku, the sixth of Hayase's descendants, introduces himself to Fushi. Much time has passed, and the Guardians have expanded their influence.

videos.title: The Young Man Who Can See
videos.overview: Fushi must stay on the move in order to keep the Nokkers from attacking, so Prince Bon accompanies him out of the castle town.

videos.title: The Holy Man's Voyage
videos.overview: Fushi, along with Kahaku, Bon and Bon's army, travel through several towns, spreading word of the Nokkers along the way.

videos.title: Heretics Betrayed
videos.overview: Kahaku asks Fushi to marry him. He seems confident that they can overcome the complications of Fushi being a shape-shifting immortal, but Fushi isn’t. Cylira returns.

videos.title: Crime and Forgiveness
videos.overview: Fushi attempts to escape from his iron cell, while Bon and Todo await their trial in their own cells.

videos.title: Beyond Dreams
videos.overview: The Kingdom of Ularis, along with Fushi, Todo, Bon's family, and Baron Spring Roll, prepare for life without Bon.

videos.title: Expanding Consciousness
videos.overview: As warned by Kahaku’s arm, the Nokkers attack the head church of the Church of Bennett, causing terrible devastation.

videos.title: Resonance
videos.overview: Fushi trains his senses in preparation for the Nokkers’ attack on Renril. He discovers a strange girl in a circus tent.

videos.title: The Value of Flesh
videos.overview: Having finished training on the derelict ship, Fushi travels to Renril, where the Nokkers are threatening to attack.

videos.title: Secret Behind the Veil
videos.overview: Fushi and his allies work to win over the trust of the people of Renril in preparation for the Nokkers’ attack.

videos.title: The Wise Man's Identity
videos.overview: The team works to prevent the Nokkers from making use of the waterways and sewers. Fushi works non-stop rebuilding all the homes, and the exhaustion begins to show.

videos.title: Morning of Rebirth
videos.overview: The city of Renril bands together around Fushi in preparation for the Nokkers’ attack. The princess introduces him to her father, King Boldron of Sonia.

videos.title: The Self, Worn Down
videos.overview: Fushi fends off the Nokkers miles away from Renril, but the Nokkers had already devised a more cunning plan.

videos.title: Three Eternal Warriors
videos.overview: The death of his three friends turns Fushi mad, and he begins defeating the Nokkers at a furious pace. But as it turns out, he may not be the only immortal.

videos.title: What You Want to Protect
videos.overview: Amidst the brutal battle against the Nokkers, Bon and Kahaku both share a desire to protect Fushi’s humanity. How they go about it, however, puts them at odds.

videos.title: Death of the Deathless
videos.overview: March begins her desperate search for Fushi, whose absence has led to the city being overrun by the Nokkers.

videos.title: And Then, Dawn
videos.overview: In the beginning, it was an orb. And Fushi was an orb once again. But though there was no certainty, there was hope.

videos.title: End of an Era
videos.overview: With the Nokkers defeated, the people of Renril rejoice, and Fushi and his friends discuss their hopes for the future.

videos.title: Peaceful World
videos.overview: Fushi awakens in a world where peace reigns. What new and old encounters await him?

videos.title: A Knot in the Soul
videos.overview: Fushi begins his new life in the present day and begins to gather his former classmates at Yuki's house.

videos.title: Mizuha
videos.overview: Mizuha is fed up with her everyday life and decides to run away.

videos.title: The One Who Vanished
videos.overview: Fushi takes care of a troubled Mizuha.

videos.title: Unheard Words
videos.overview: Fushi and his revived friends joins Yuki and Mizuha at school.

videos.title: Proof of Peace
videos.overview: Fushi struggles to maintain the peace between Tonari and Mizuha.

videos.title: The Attack
videos.overview: The mystery of the Nokker inside Mimori is clarified a little, as it seeks Fushi at the school to attack him.

videos.title: Trouble
videos.overview: Hirotoshi reveals Mimori's deeply troubled past.

videos.title: Rejected Life
videos.overview: Fushi and Bon try to save Mimori at Hirotoshi's request, but a new Nokker appears.

videos.title: Become as People
videos.overview: Rikuya is found destroyed. The Nokkers confront Fushi.

videos.title: Their Home
videos.overview: Fushi has an opportunity to deal with the Nokker in Izumi's body.

videos.title: Flying Bug
videos.overview: Fushi transforms into small creatures to keep an eye on Mizuha and Funa. Meanwhile, Eko gives Yuki an idea.

videos.title: Number One
videos.overview: Fushi goes back to school, but as Fuuna. He learns about what people really think.

videos.title: Where One Belongs
videos.overview: Gugu confesses to being homesick. Fushi struggles to come to terms with his friends growing distant.

videos.title: Leaving Alone
videos.overview: Bon describes how Fushi's friends spent their time after he went to sleep centuries prior.

videos.title: Connective
videos.overview: Fushi and his friends look for ways to get back in touch with Mizuha.

videos.title: Invisible Battle
videos.overview: Fushi tries desperately to negotiate with Mizuha. Meanwhile, an impostor attacks the school.

videos.title: A Willingness to Believe
videos.overview: Tonari, Aiko and their schoolmates fight the Fushi impostor.

videos.title: Clean Water
videos.overview: Yuki and the crew negotiate a peace with the Guardians.

videos.title: Coexist
videos.overview: Fushi and his friends return to Yuki's place to discuss how they should avoid being arrested.

videos.title: Stay Here
videos.overview: The class needs to decide what they're doing after middle school. Fushi's decision is much weightier.

videos.title: To Fushi
videos.overview: The Beholder leaves Fushi with a memo.
